from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,date
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
ROOT=Path.cwd()
R32="reports/research/510300_dr007_transaction_amount_source_and_prior_use_probe_v1"
R33="reports/research/510300_dr007_transaction_amount_history_acquisition_v1"
OUT=ROOT/R33
assert not OUT.exists(),"E33已存在不覆盖"
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256((ROOT/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def readj(p):return json.loads((ROOT/p).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
r=readj(R32+"/result.json")
assert r["candidate_amount_field_exists"] and r["provider_authenticated_api_calls"]==0
now=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
refs=[R32+"/protocol.json",R32+"/result.json",R32+"/source_gate.json",R32+"/字段身份_单位_全部两个有限样例.json",
 "config/510300_asymmetric_stress_hazard_v1_dr007_tushare_v1_0_2.yaml",
 "research/asymmetric_stress_hazard_dr007_tushare_v1_0_2.py",
 "reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/protocol.json"]
chunks=[]
for year in range(2015,2027):
 chunks.append({"start_date":"20150105" if year==2015 else str(year)+"0101","end_date":"20260814" if year==2026 else str(year)+"1231"})
proposal={"experiment_id":"E33","proposed_study_id":"510300_DR007_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_HISTORY_ACQUISITION_V1",
 "proposed_at":now,"status":"PROPOSED_CONFIRMED_SAME_INSTRUMENT_AMOUNT_HISTORY_ONLY_NOT_REGISTERED",
 "question":"E32已确认同DR007成交额真实字段；用现有已授权账户/合同运输读取同API同代码原12年分块，增加amount而不改旧数据。一次运输选择，不绕过凭据到期、不支付或改旧采集程序；无有效凭据/失败响应则停止不重试。全部字段/日期/量缺失及旧weight一致性保存，覆盖全部原成熟训练成员和决定日、建立时钟后才另注册唯一联合评分，不把源可读当收益有效。",
 "candidate_identity":"repo_daily / DR007.IB / repo_maturity=DR007 / amount万元",
 "field_list":["ts_code","trade_date","repo_maturity","weight","amount"],
 "chunks":chunks,"budget":{"provider_requests_max":12,"max_rows_per_chunk":2000,"parallel_workers_max":2,
 "connect_timeout_seconds":10,"read_timeout_seconds":25,"total_download_bytes_max":16777216,
 "transport_selection_once":True,"retry_failures":False,"use_expired_proxy":False,"new_payments":False},
 "references":[{"path":p,"sha256":sha(p)} for p in refs],
 "stage":"只采集/源门，0模型拟合/账户/新前瞻；后续评分需独立登记。"}
p=ROOT/R32/"next_experiment.json";assert not p.exists();p.write_text(json.dumps(proposal,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
OUT.mkdir()
protocol={"study_id":proposal["proposed_study_id"],"experiment_id":"E33","registered_at":now,
 "previous_goal_turn_classification":"PROGRESS_E31_NEW_Q2_DATED_BODY_FOUR_ROUNDED_POINT_VALUES_AND_METHOD_MISMATCH_COMPLETED",
 "question":proposal["question"],"candidate_identity":proposal["candidate_identity"],"field_list":proposal["field_list"],
 "chunks":chunks,"budget":proposal["budget"],
 "availability":"旧weight的NEXT_TRADING_DAY_OPEN_AFTER_RATE_DATE仅冻结对齐参照；成交额原逐日公开时钟/版本未自动认证，另记录未知。",
 "full_training_support_required":True,"drop_or_zero_fill_missing_forbidden":True,
 "existing_transport_credentials_in_memory_only":True,"old_source_and_program_edits":False,
 "parents":proposal["references"]+[{"path":R32+"/next_experiment.json","sha256":sha(R32+"/next_experiment.json")}],
 "provider_paid_subscription_change_authorized":False,
 "new_fits":0,"new_training_labels":0,"new_full_accounts":0,"source_code_edits":0,
 "orders_authorized":False,"new_prospective_forecasts_enabled":False,"current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET",
 "goal_achieved":False}
(OUT/"protocol.json").write_text(json.dumps(protocol,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"登记":"E33真实DR007成交额历史采集","分块":12,"带凭据API":"复用既有授权运输，禁止到期绕过/新增支付","模型":0},ensure_ascii=False))
